summary: The resolver exists and is correct: packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45 defines resolveHideBranding (organization setting wins, else the entity's own), :85-110 splits team vs owner, :116-181 exposes shouldHideBrandingForEvent / ...ForTeamEvent / ...ForUserEvent, and :50-80 getHideBranding by id. Only the booking-page surfaces consume it — apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:208, apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:311, apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61,104, apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36, apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:251-253 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx — which is exactly why the booking page honours the plan and nothing else does. (1) Emails: the Cal.com wordmark is rendered by packages/emails/src/components/EmailBodyLogo.tsx:8-9,49-65 and gated in packages/emails/src/components/BaseEmailHtml.tsx:26,200 by a single hideLogo prop. A repository-wide search for hideLogo returns 3 hits in 2 files; the only site that ever passes it is packages/emails/src/templates/BaseScheduledEmail.tsx:68, hideLogo={Boolean(props.calEvent.platformClientId)} — a platform/OAuth condition, never hideBranding. Every confirmation, reminder, reschedule and no-show-fee email built on that template is therefore branded for a self-serve paid customer. (2) The pre-booking code email: packages/emails/src/templates/VerifyEmailByCode.tsx:10-13 mounts BaseEmailHtml with no hideLogo at all, and its payload type packages/emails/lib/types/email-types.ts:15-23 (EmailVerifyCode) carries no branding field, so neither the template nor its sender class packages/emails/templates/attendee-verify-email.ts can express suppression. (3) Team-vs-personal divergence: the booking and payment pipelines recompute the flag inline from the owner column only — packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2620,2804,2819 (!!eventType.owner?.hideBranding || !!platformClientId), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:458,471, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:103, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:464, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:404, and after a paid booking packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:231 (hideBranding: !!booking.eventType?.owner?.hideBranding). A team event has no eventType.owner, so all of these evaluate false for teams regardless of the team's setting. (4) A second, competing rule lives in packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:519-534, a private shouldHideBranding(booking) that returns booking.eventType.team.hideBranding when a team exists and booking.user.hideBranding otherwise, with no organization inheritance — the opposite branch order from the correct arm at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:97,264 and WorkflowService.ts:133, which do call getHideBranding. The Prisma selects feeding these paths (packages/prisma/selects/payment.ts:55,62,65, packages/features/bookings/lib/payment/getBooking.ts:40, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:111, packages/features/bookings/lib/getBookingToDelete.ts:57, packages/features/bookings/repositories/BookingRepository.ts:462) fetch only the owner's hideBranding and must widen to team + parent for the resolver to be usable there. packages/types/Calendar.d.ts is named because BaseScheduledEmail.tsx:6,68 reads the flag off CalendarEvent, which today exposes platformClientId but no branding field; that file's contents are the one claim I could not read verbatim, because the plumbline server dropped its connection (ConnectionRefused) after the evidence above was collected — the index was confirmed live at 4081d11fbec98a4267f6946877cc138a1a24505b for every citation given, and this session was fresh, never resumed or re-attempted.
